title: Supporting a Friend Through Divorce
paragraphs: Ketika teman terdekatnya mengalami perceraian yang sulit, Sumaya tidak yakin persis bagaimana membantunya, khawatir mengatakan hal yang salah bisa secara tidak sengaja menambah kepedihan temannya yang sudah signifikan. Alih-alih terus-menerus memberi nasihat tentang apa yang seharusnya dilakukan temannya selanjutnya, Sumaya hanya membuat dirinya tersedia, membantu tugas praktis seperti mengasuh anak dan urusan sehari-hari selama minggu-minggu paling membebani.

Temannya kemudian mengakui bahwa dukungan praktis dan diam itu lebih berarti daripada nasihat apa pun, karena ia sebagian besar hanya butuh seseorang untuk berbagi beban, bukan diberi tahu apa yang harus dipikirkan. Sumaya menyadari melalui pengalaman ini bahwa mendukung seseorang melewati kesulitan seringkali berarti mendengarkan dan membantu secara praktis, alih-alih mencoba menyelesaikan kepedihan emosional mereka secara langsung.
answerKey: When her closest friend went through a difficult divorce, Sumaya was unsure exactly how to help, worried that saying the wrong thing might unintentionally add to her friend's already significant pain. Rather than offering constant advice about what her friend should do next, Sumaya simply made herself available, helping with practical tasks like childcare and errands during the most overwhelming weeks. Her friend later admitted that the practical, quiet support meant more than any advice could have, since she mostly needed someone to share the load rather than tell her what to think. Sumaya realized through this experience that supporting someone through hardship often means listening and helping practically, rather than trying to solve their emotional pain directly.
